text:
Marisol: Heads up — it's time for the quarterly entitlement curation. I want to try a tighter triage flow that combines KMS grant activity + service-account last-used to auto-prioritize admin removals. Thoughts?
Alejandro: +1 on using last-used. Can you share the query you had in mind for KMS logs? :eyes:
Marisol: sketch below — this will pull grants and decryption attempts in the last 90d across projects:
```
gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:"CreateGrant" OR protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt"' --freshness=90d --project=redwood-prod --format=json
```
Marisol: We then join by grantee principal and look up service-account oauth token usage via bigquery UA table. Sort by (last_used, number_of_hosts) and surface top 200 candidates for manual review.
Priya: That seems sensible. Two quick asks: 1) ensure we only show grants that map to roles with high privilege (Owner, Admin, kmsAdmin) and 2) redact any principal emails in the export until handoff.
Marisol: Agreed on both. I'll add a filter for policyBinding.role matches and a redaction step that replaces user emails with owner IDs.
Sam: How do we handle cross-account grants and long-lived CI principals? We can't just blanket-remove if token rotation isn't in place.
Marisol: Good call. Plan: tag CI principals where we see non-human UA strings or long-lived tokens, then mark those as "requires mitigation plan" instead of immediate removal. We'll also generate a checklist: rotate key / rotate token / rebind minimal roles.
Alejandro: Can ops-bot help synthesize runbook links in the output? E.g., for each flagged principal attach the rotation runbook and the ticket template.
Marisol: ops-bot — can you inject runbook links when given a principal list?
ops-bot: I can. Upload a CSV to /tmp/entitlement-curation with columns (principal_id, project, flagged_reason) and I will return a report with pointers and a prefilled JIRA template.
Priya: One more thing — audit logging retention. If we surface activity back >90d for some principals, we should log that as evidence in the attestation record. Is 365d retention available for KMS logs?
Alejandro: For prod yes, we have 365d. For sandbox some projects only keep 30d. We'll add an indicator in the output when full history isn't available.
Marisol: Action items: 1) I'll build the initial query + redaction script and push to infra-reports by EOD Thursday. 2) Alejandro to add retention flag to export. 3) Priya to confirm runbook links and redaction policy. 4) Sam to sketch mitigation checklist for CI principals.
Sam: I'll draft mitigation checklist and include typical rotation commands and a fallback plan if rotation breaks CI.
Priya: I'll post the runbook links and the email redaction rules in this thread once confirmed.
Marisol: Thanks all — if we can keep the manual review to under 200 candidates this round it's a win. Will post the CSV and request reviewers from platform/security next week. :thumbsup:
